claim_verdicts.evidence: Round 2: "By default" now in section 3 (Claims left in place), section 4 and summary 4. Docs: "Retain (default): PVCs from the volumeClaimTemplate are not affected when their Pod is deleted." "Deleting and/or scaling a StatefulSet down will not delete the volumes". Tutorial: "When you recreated the StatefulSet and it relaunched web-0, its original PersistentVolume was remounted."

"If no StorageClass is specified, then the default StorageClass will be used." Capture at stage-3: `data-db-0 Bound pvc-... 1Gi RWO standard`, i.e. the claim from the template with no storageClassName got `standard`. Round 2: section 4 now says "the cluster's default StorageClass, `standard`" and no longer re-asserts "on one node".

Execution evidence (captured run): first db-0 on a new claim -> `orders: 12` (seeded); replacement db-0 on the same claim logs `PostgreSQL Database directory appears to contain a database; Skipping initialization`, orders still 12. Docker Official Image docs are not a `docs` root in versions.yaml, so no documentation sentence quoted; verdict rests on the captured output only.

"As the name says, the emptyDir volume is initially empty." "When a Pod is removed from a node for any reason, the data in the emptyDir is deleted permanently." Section 2's new gloss "a volume created empty with the Pod and deleted with it" matches. With claim 7, a replacement Pod reseeds and loses rows written since.

"`.spec.strategy.type` can be "Recreate" or "RollingUpdate". "RollingUpdate" is the default value." maxUnavailable: "calculated from percentage by rounding down... The default value is 25%." maxSurge: "calculated from the percentage by rounding up. The default value is 25%." replicas 1 -> surge 1, unavailable 0: new Pod first. The Deployment db in the repo sets no strategy (grep). One Pod template -> same claim for every Pod.

Each Pod gets its own claim ("each Pod receives one PersistentVolumeClaim"). Copying data to a new member is the application's job, not the StatefulSet's: in the replicated example "The second init container, named clone-mysql, performs a clone operation on a replica Pod the first time it starts up on an empty PersistentVolume." base/db.yaml has no such container. Empty folder -> init scripts seed 12 (claim 7).

"The Service targets TCP port 9376 on any Pod with the app.kubernetes.io/name: MyApp label." "The controller for that Service continuously scans for Pods that match its selector, and then makes any necessary updates to the set of EndpointSlices for the Service." Service db selects `app: db`, the label of the StatefulSet's Pod template, so db-0 and db-1 would both be targets.
